description: This source file provides debugging support functions for voice wake recognition, including transcript logging, command matching, and summary generation.

classes.name: TranscriptSummary
classes.description: A simple data structure holding a flag indicating if the transcript is text-only and the timing count of segments.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether the given transcript should be logged based on previous logs, log level, and timing constraints.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to generate a WakeWordGateMatch if the transcript matches a text-only command based on triggers and configuration.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of the transcript, indicating if it's text-only and counting relevant segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the match result with timing and command length information.
